assertion: Combined text remains horizontal in one vertical 1em cell, including fullwidth digits, compression, both column directions, underline and one emphasis mark for the whole cell.

browser.reason: Reviewed all three browsers plus enlarged native and difference images. Chrome and Firefox use width variants/compression to retain the text height; WebKit shrinks some multi-character cells in both axes. Native one-cell advances, fullwidth digits, both column directions and emphasis count agree with Chrome. Remaining 5623 pixels (maximum 235) are text-edge/subpixel differences and UA-defined annotation/decoration placement. Numerical tests independently assert the 1em advance, compression, inheritance, box-boundary handling and backward seeks.
